article.title: Follow and Subscribe Podcast: Episode Guide to All 26 Episodes
article.author: Jeremy Swain
article.summary: Every episode of Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast, with a one-line guide to each and where to watch or listen.
article.leadParagraph: Follow and Subscribe is the 3000 Studios podcast. It has 26 episodes so far, on YouTube and Spotify, with notes on Substack. Start anywhere with this guide.

sections.heading: Episodes 1 to 10
body: Episode 1: Mentally Happy. The premiere of Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast — hosts Follow and Subscribe open the studio for the first time.

Episode 2: The Summit at Midnight. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, your favorite alien, broadcasting from the top floor of the empire. Featuring the song “Got A Lot Going On” and a surprise call from Duchess Wanda from Tallahassee.

Episode 3: The Library That Never Sleeps. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, and today we broadcast from my favorite room in the empire: the library. Featuring the song “After Hours Heaven” and a surprise call from Professor Noodle from Chicago.

Episode 4: Radar Is Dead. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, coming to you from the hangar studio, where the sky is close enough to high-five. Featuring the song “Electric Skies” and a surprise call from Captain Biscuit from Denver.

Episode 5: The Big Kindness. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, and today the studio smells like cinnamon and good decisions. Featuring the song “I'm Feelin' It” and a surprise call from Grandma Pearl from Savannah.

Episode 6: Seven Listeners. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, and I would like to begin with a formal announcement: we have listeners. Featuring the song “Midnight Haunt” and a surprise call from Tommy Two-Tones from Nashville.

Episode 7: The Night Shift. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, reporting for duty on the most noble shift of all: the night shift. Featuring the song “Room Goes Cold” and a surprise call from Nurse Nightingale from Phoenix.

Episode 8: One Free Finding. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, broadcasting on the spookiest night of the year — and I am wearing my formal cape. Featuring the song “Why Do I” and a surprise call from Count Snacc-ula from Transylvania, Ohio.

Episode 9: Nobody Sits. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, and I am legally required to say it: we got an extra hour today, and I have already spent mine twice. Featuring the song “Go Get the Shovel” and a surprise call from Pastor Pancake from Memphis.

Episode 10: The Laws of the House. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, and tonight this court — I mean this studio — is in session. Featuring the song “If You Don't Play” and a surprise call from Judge Rudy from Austin.

sections.heading: Episodes 11 to 20
body: Episode 11: Empire Before Breakfast. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, and today is a double feature: the biggest civic day of the year, and the grand finale of our catch-up season. Featuring the song “Legit Funky” and a surprise call from First-Time Fran from Erie.

Episode 12: The Morning After the Map Changed. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, your favorite alien, broadcasting live from the morning loft of the empire. Featuring the song “Got A Lot Going On” and a surprise call from Sergeant Sunshine from Biloxi.

Episode 13: Markets Throw a Parade. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, your favorite alien, broadcasting from the rooftop studio where the sunset does our lighting for free. Featuring the song “After Hours Heaven” and a surprise call from Madame Zaza from Las Vegas.

Episode 14: AI Goes to the Ballot Box. Broadcasting from the night library studio, where the books are awake so we don't have to be quiet. Featuring the song “Electric Skies” and a surprise call from Uncle Pickles from Kalamazoo.

Episode 15: The Market Held Its Breath. Broadcasting from the lake sunrise studio, where the water is calm, the coffee is not, and neither am I. Featuring the song “I'm Feelin' It” and a surprise call from Coach Biscotti from Buffalo.

Episode 16: The Robots Are Hiring Robots. Broadcasting from the greenhouse studio, where the plants are thriving, the light is perfect, and I have been photosynthesizing compliments all afternoon. Featuring the song “Midnight Haunt” and a surprise call from Princess Pickle from Portland.

Episode 17: Vice City Countdown. Broadcasting from the deco theater studio, where the marquee is lit, the microphones are vintage, and I am dressed like I own the balcony. I do not. Featuring the song “Room Goes Cold” and a surprise call from Detective Donut from Detroit.

Episode 18: The Lunch Rush Special. Broadcasting from the diner studio, where the coffee is bottomless, the counter seats are spinning, and I have already been offered two specials and a side of hash browns. Featuring the song “Go Get the Shovel” and a surprise call from Captain Waffles from Wichita.

Episode 19: Saturday Gets Loud. Broadcasting from the farmers market loft studio, where the brick is exposed, the coffee is enormous, and Saturday gets loud. Featuring the song “Why Do I” and a surprise call from Baron von Brunch from Baltimore.

Episode 20: High Noon at the Empire. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, broadcasting from the sky lounge studio, forty floors above the city. Featuring the song “Legit Funky” and a surprise call from Miss Maple from Minneapolis.

sections.heading: Episodes 21 to 26
body: Episode 21: Golden Hour, Full Power. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, broadcasting as the golden hour lights the studio. Featuring the song “Electric Skies” and a surprise call from Captain Comet from Cape Canaveral.

Episode 22: The Night Owl Network. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, keeping the late crowd company on the night owl network. Featuring the song “If You Don't Play” and a surprise call from DJ Moonpie from Mobile.

Episode 23: Sunday Starts Bright. Welcome back to Follow and Subscribe, the 3000 Studios podcast! I'm Follow, and Sunday starts bright. Featuring the song “Got Alot Going On” and a surprise call from Sister Sunrise from Savannah.

Episode 24: Noon in the Observatory. Broadcasting from the observatory studio at high noon, where the telescopes are pointed at everything except the obvious. Featuring the song “Midnight Haunt” and a surprise call from Penny Telescope from Tucson.

Episode 25: The Golden Depot. Broadcasting from the golden depot studio, where every arrival is on time and every departure is dramatic. Featuring the song “Room Goes Cold” and a surprise call from Conductor Coco from Chattanooga.
Episode 26: Stars After Dark. Broadcasting after dark, under a sky full of stars. Featuring the song “After Hours Heaven” and a surprise call from Moondust Molly from Marfa.

sections.heading: Where to watch and listen
body: Every episode is on the podcast page at https://3000studios.vip/podcast, on the 3000 Studios YouTube channel and on Spotify.
